instruction: Set a custom keybinding in VS Code to toggle the primary Side Bar: map Ctrl+Alt+S to the command "workbench.action.toggleSidebarVisibility" and save.

verification.condition: Inspect ~/.config/Code/User/keybindings.json for an entry containing "command": "workbench.action.toggleSidebarVisibility" and "key": "ctrl+alt+s"
verification.expected_result: The keybindings.json file contains the specified command bound to Ctrl+Alt+S.
